command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
if [ -e "$change" ]; then
  echo "$change is still active - archive it with: openspec archive $change_name --yes, then move it under openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/"
  exit 1
fi
# Measured from where the task branch started, so an earlier archive of the same name does not count.
# Where the task branch started: the box has no origin, so never origin/main.
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }
targets=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } \
  | grep -E "^openspec/changes/archive/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$change_name/proposal\.md$" \
  | sort -u | sed 's|/proposal\.md$||')
count=$(printf '%s' "$targets" | grep -c . || true)
[ "$count" = "1" ] || { echo "expected exactly one new openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-$change_name/ holding the change's proposal.md, found $count:"; echo "$targets"; exit 1; }

command:misplaced=$(find openspec/changes/archive -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'; find openspec/changes/archive -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d ! -name '[0-1][0-9]'; find openspec/changes/archive -mindepth 3 -maxdepth 3 -type d ! -name '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]-*'); [ -z "$misplaced" ] || { echo "$misplaced"; echo "these archive entries break the YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-<name> layout - see .claude/rules/archive-path.md"; exit 1; }
command:if grep -rn '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' openspec/changes/archive --include=tasks.md; then echo "the archived tasks listed above are still open - the change was archived unfinished"; exit 1; fi

command:since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^archive#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
outside=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep . | grep -v '^openspec/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the archive stage changes nothing outside openspec/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
